The URL field is in the Edit form now. Refresh **http://maker:4001** and let's confirm it.

> **1.** On any bookmark in **All**, click **Edit**. You'll now see the **Link (URL)** at the top of the form, above the title and description.
> **2.** Change part of the URL if you like, then click **Save changes**. The bookmark keeps your title/description, and its site name and icon update to match the new link.
> **3.** Try Edit again — this time tick **"Re-fetch page details from this link when I save"** before saving. The card briefly re-gathers details and fills the title, description, icon, and preview image fresh from the (new) link.

One decision I want your read on:

- I made re-fetching **optional, via a checkbox** — by default, editing the URL keeps the title and description you've already curated, and only if you tick the box does it pull fresh details and overwrite them. My reasoning was that you may have deliberately corrected the title, and changing the URL slightly (say, removing a tracking parameter) shouldn't wipe your edits. Does that default — *keep my text unless I ask to re-fetch* — match what you'd want?

Give it a try and tell me whether editing the link this way works for you.
